releases.notes:
Fixed some issues.
Since this version, Cloth Config is also required for Forge and Quilt.
For Minecraft 1.18.1 and below, if you're using Quilt Loader, please directly download the Fabric version mod.

- Optimized the code.
- Fixed the bug related to configurations.
- Now it can affect block registries now. Added an option to determine whether to affect blocks.
- Supports Fabric and Quilt.
- Quit old entrypoints.
